description: The host this check exists for. Both BPF parameters are hardened in the running kernel and neither is written to any configuration file, so the hardening disappears at the next reboot. KERNEL-0006 reports PASS because the running value is right; KERNEL-0007 does not see it at all, because a parameter no file mentions has nothing to drift from. A sysctl.d file is present and sets other things, so this is not a host without configuration — it is a host whose configuration forgot these two.
